purpose: The per-axis denominator of the by-axis tenant-difference probe (kit-2026-09 section 5 rule 4), pinned so it cannot be shrunk to reach a threshold (WO-EVI-02 R4 amendment 3).
direction: A denominator BELOW its pin is a regression. A denominator ABOVE its pin is also refused, with the instruction to raise the pin in the same commit, so the published population and this file never name different sets. A reviewed semantic-identity exclusion is the one lawful subtraction: it is pinned beside the denominator it subtracts from (notApplicable per axis) and under the exclusion revision it was reviewed at, so neither can drift on its own.
